steps.code:
# Count friends made since October 1, 2022 (start of October last year)
from datetime import datetime

# friends_page is the list of friends from page 0
count = 0
for friend in friends_page:
    friends_since = datetime.fromisoformat(friend['friends_since'])
    if friends_since >= datetime(2022, 10, 1):
        count += 1

print(count)
